[2] Define byte-identical export for repository/module artifacts when preservation semantics require exporting the exact validated original bytes.

semantics.byte_rule: Byte-identical mode emits the exact source bytes without normalization/reformatting.
semantics.canonical_export_rule: Other semantic exports may legitimately reserialize canonical data, but must not be labeled byte-identical package export.
semantics.fallback_rule: If exact source bytes are unavailable, byte-identical export hard-fails rather than regenerating approximately.
semantics.hash_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Stored and exported package hashes must match. [2] Exported bytes must reproduce the exact expected content hash.
semantics.identity_rule: Export operation/result identity is separate from artifact identity.
semantics.metadata_rule: Transport/archive metadata may be external to preserved artifact bytes.
semantics.no_rebuild_rule: Export does not reserialize, normalize or rebuild the package under a byte-identical claim.
semantics.provenance_rule: Export result identifies source package identity/hash.
semantics.rule: When byte-identical export is claimed, exported bytes exactly match the stored package bytes.
semantics.semantic_rule: Byte identity is a distribution-integrity property, not semantic identity.
semantics.source_rule: Export source is exact validated artifact revision/bytes.
